note: A function call now opens its earlier definitions, from the same method or the same verb family in older agendas, as nested layers in its pop-up, up to 5 deep. Pending story promises from #thryd show as a faint pulsing ? on the objects they name, plus a quiet line in the corner, and flash once when they resolve. Open exceptions show in the tap menu and in the pop-up. promises.json and exceptions.json are read-only exports of #thryd ledgers.
